## Purpose

Browse recorded proposals for one project, optionally narrowed to one task.

## When a playbook uses it

A local operator or project supervisor reviewing shadow history. Ordinary workers use `test_selection_show` for their own task.

## How it works internally

The handler enforces project operator scope, then queries newest-first records with an optional timestamp cursor, task filter and limit. See [`test_selection_commands.py`](../../../src/commands/test_selection_commands.py) and [`service.py`](../../../src/test_selection/service.py).

## Side effects and persistence

Reads `test_selections` only; cached recommendations still appear as separate invocations.

## Failure modes and diagnostics

`out_of_scope` refuses plain workers and supervisors naming another project. Use `before` from the oldest returned creation timestamp for the next page.

## Example step

Command-step payload (promotion/revocation examples require a local operator context):

```json
{"command": "test_selection_list", "args": {"project_id": "agent-queue", "limit": 50}}
```
